answer: Beacon Slot Challenge forces each new agent to solve a hash puzzle seeded by a verifiable random beacon, so no attacker can precompute answers before the seed is public. Each forged identity pays a full gas transaction to the beacon contract, leaving an ember of audit-able cost per fake agent. Verified identities form an island cut off from sybil noise, as slow to erode as a glacier, because each seed is drawn only at the exact block of registration.
